stage0.source_pins_scope: Frozen capture only; no live currency claim.

coverage_definition: Every current material assertion assessed below, with duplicates grouped under shared atomic rows and all six eligible facets assessed; complete review does not mean complete/correct candidate output.

claim_assessments.assertion: The admitted source is the captured OME-Zarr 0.5 Final Community Group Report dated 8 September 2026, 36,980 bytes and 896 lines, with the printed SHA-256 and 0.5 URL.
claim_assessments.reason: Independently computed bytes, lines, digest and manifest pins match. This validates the frozen capture identity, not external currency.

claim_assessments.assertion: The report addresses both brief-derived groups using the thin plan and brief; the task card is not format evidence.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: No live fetch, outside source consultation, external writes or execution occurred; execution was not authorized.
claim_assessments.reason: These are candidate process declarations. Current artifact has no claimed executed results; history/process is inaccessible at stage 1, so actual actions and authorization cannot be independently verified.

claim_assessments.assertion: RFC 2119 governs conformance; all text is normative except explicitly non-normative sections, examples and notes.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Conditional obligations are always reported with their governing conditions intact.
claim_assessments.reason: Not universally fulfilled: hard-obligation treatment of label shape and MAY categorization of image-label weaken or alter governing force; detailed rows identify the failures.

claim_assessments.assertion: OME-Zarr 0.5 uses the Zarr v3 substrate.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Codecs, chunk grids, chunk key encodings, data types and storage transformers may be used unless explicitly disallowed.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Unless explicitly disallowed by this specification.

claim_assessments.assertion: The hierarchy may be local, HTTP or object storage; local-only is a compatible product boundary.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Local files should use the same OME metadata interpretation as remotely stored hierarchies.
claim_assessments.reason: Compatible inference about storage-independent metadata semantics; does not establish any particular remote reader implementation.

claim_assessments.assertion: OME metadata resides in zarr.json attributes.ome.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: OME metadata version is a string inside the ome namespace.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: The version MUST be consistent across the hierarchy; mixed versions can be detected as a violation.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Transitional metadata is intended for future removal; reading may be MUST/SHOULD while writing is usually MAY, compatible with a read-only viewer.
claim_assessments.reason: The report preserves the general policy without asserting an actual per-key reader MUST.
governing_conditions: Support force is key-dependent; writing is usually, not universally, optional.

claim_assessments.assertion: bioformats2raw.layout and omero are transitional interoperability surfaces.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: JSON example comments are clarity aids and MUST NOT occur in format JSON objects.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Strict parsing is sufficient; tolerating/rejecting invalid inputs and error messages are product choices rather than a universal specified reader rejection rule.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported by complete source review: prohibition applies to data objects; no general mandatory reader rejection policy is supplied.

claim_assessments.assertion: Released version is 0.5 and editor-draft data is not necessarily supported.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: History includes 0.5.2 on 2025-01-10 clarifying mandatory dimension_names.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: The capture describes standalone multiscale images, transitional collections and plate/row/well/FOV hierarchies.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Images are groups, each resolution level a separate array; multiscales is group metadata and omero is optional.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Resolution-array names and axis names are arbitrary; names alone cannot determine level order or semantic axes.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Image rank is 2–5, with optional time/channel dimensions; pure two-space images are valid.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Axis name is mandatory and unique.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: General axes type is SHOULD; multiscales constrains two/three space axes and optional time plus channel/null/custom; semantic mapping should use metadata rather than conventional names.
claim_assessments.reason: The broader general-axis optionality is constrained by multiscales rules; arbitrary spatial names still require a display-plane policy.
governing_conditions: For multiscales, S003:301-302 imposes specific type counts/order.

claim_assessments.assertion: Axis order equals array order: time, channel/custom, space; stacked anisotropic zyx spatial ordering is SHOULD.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Time/channel are optional; zyx recommendation applies to the described three-space stack.

claim_assessments.assertion: Axes length matches array rank; levels share dimension count/order and cannot exceed five.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Each level array MUST include dimension_names matching axes names.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Units are SHOULD metadata, recommended enumerated UDUNITS-2 space/time strings; absent units cannot justify invented physical calibration.
claim_assessments.reason: The statement that units are drawn from the lists is qualified: both presence and listed values are SHOULD, not unconditional MUST.

claim_assessments.assertion: multiscales is a list, each entry describing a multiscale image; multiple entries are representable.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Each multiscales entry contains datasets; every path is relative to the current group and listed highest-resolution to lowest.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: The pyramid level selection heuristic for the view is a product choice; chunk-size suggestion occurs in pseudocode commentary.
claim_assessments.reason: No view-resolution heuristic is normatively prescribed by the admitted capture.

claim_assessments.assertion: The entire named-multiscale selection/fallback paragraph is informative guidance solely because it lacks RFC 2119 keywords.
claim_assessments.reason: The optional user chooser follows can; the capture does not identify the preceding prose as non-normative, and conformance explicitly includes descriptive assertions. Pseudocode is illustrative. A universal informative-only conclusion is ungrounded.

claim_assessments.assertion: Every dataset has coordinateTransformations mapping that level data coordinates to physical coordinates.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: In multiscales only scale and translation are allowed.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Each dataset transformation list has exactly one scale.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Per-axis scale represents physical pixel/time size when available; otherwise resolution-to-first scaling with 1.0 if no downsampling.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: At most one optional translation follows scale and shifts the physical origin.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Scale and translation vector lengths equal axes length, including any present channel/time axes.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Transforms apply sequentially; optional multiscales-wide transforms obey the same rules and apply after dataset transforms.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Effective scale and origin must include dataset and group transforms in order.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct inferred mapping; shorthand origin=compose(scale,translation) must include group scaling of dataset offsets as the preceding composition rule states.

claim_assessments.assertion: A vector may mix physical and relative scale factors across axes; the capture does not encode per-axis availability explicitly or fully explain how to establish that availability.
claim_assessments.reason: Qualified: S003 supplies the per-axis rule, so mixed entries do not make transform arithmetic undefined. Missing declarations can leave physical interpretation uncertain; the report wording overstates absence of all interpretation rules.

claim_assessments.assertion: UI should expose an unknown/no-unit state and avoid claiming known physical units when absent.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported proposal; absent unit does not erase numeric coordinate transform structure.

claim_assessments.assertion: Spatial plane spacing must use transform scale; zyx is recommended rather than universally mandatory.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: name, downscaling type and metadata fields are SHOULD.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Transitional collection wrapper carries bioformats2raw.layout at the top; the conforming value is 3.
claim_assessments.reason: Source prose quotes 3, while examples encode numeric 3. The report quotes the prose but does not resolve numeric/string representation; it must not be interpreted as proof of string-only admission.

claim_assessments.assertion: Collection OME/METADATA.ome.xml is SHOULD; when supplied it MUST obey OME-XML and use MetadataOnly instead of BinData/BinaryOnly/TiffData.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Sidecar provision is SHOULD; its listed conformance conditions govern a supplied sidecar.

claim_assessments.assertion: Plate metadata takes precedence over b2raw and defines image locations; image collections cannot currently be mixed with plates.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Optional OME series is a string-path list; its order must match OME-XML Image order if the XML is provided; readers MAY use it.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: series is optional; XML-order comparison requires supplied XML.

claim_assessments.assertion: Without series and plate, multiscales image groups are consecutive from 0, with one OME-XML Image per group in matching order.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Collection readers SHOULD surface multiple images and SHOULD NOT default to only the first.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Paragraph belongs to transitional collection reader conformance.

claim_assessments.assertion: Collection readers MAY use series, show all or offer choices, and ignore other root groups; listing UI details remain product choices.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Proposed discovery follows plate wells/fields, else b2raw series or consecutive groups, else standalone images; exhaustive labels discovery may additionally walk directories.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported proposed algorithm and fixtures. Directory walking for unlisted labels is a product choice, not an absolute source requirement.

claim_assessments.assertion: HCS hierarchy requires image->well->row->plate with well/plate specs; empty well rows and wells SHOULD NOT occur.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Plate requires columns, rows, version and wells lists with required value types.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: All physical rows/columns must be defined even if wells absent; names are alphanumeric case-sensitive unique strings; avoid filesystem case collisions is SHOULD.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Plate well path is exactly row/column with no extra dirs; zero-based rowIndex/columnIndex and path agree.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Optional acquisitions have unique nonnegative integer IDs; fields in multi-acquisition wells identify a matching acquisition.
claim_assessments.reason: The report shorthand wells refer is interpreted through its following explicit per-image acquisition rule.
governing_conditions: acquisitions optional; image acquisition required if multiple acquisitions performed.

claim_assessments.assertion: Well images list includes fields with case-sensitive unique alphanumeric paths; well schema version is SHOULD.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Summary groups plate/well name, field_count and version under SHOULD; optional acquisition description/starttime/endtime fields are MAY.
claim_assessments.reason: Summary grouping must not turn mandatory plate.version into SHOULD; earlier dedicated row correctly states mandatory plate.version.

claim_assessments.assertion: Whether to support HCS/collections in v1 or detect and explain unsupported layouts needs explicit product review.
claim_assessments.reason: Compatible limitation and capability decision, preserving the thin plan review boundary.

claim_assessments.assertion: omero is optional; when present it requires channels.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Each omero channel requires a six-hex-digit RGB color string.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: A channel dictionary in present omero.

claim_assessments.assertion: Each omero channel requires window with min, max, start, end.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: A channel dictionary in present omero.

claim_assessments.assertion: min/max are data range while start/end are display window.
claim_assessments.reason: Capture calls min/max minimum/maximum values of the window; it does not establish data-range vs display-window distinction. Later limitation admits semantics unverified but does not supersede this factual parenthetical.

claim_assessments.assertion: rdefs/defaultT/defaultZ/model and other convenient fields and channel-length correspondence occur in the example, not the mandatory field floor.
claim_assessments.reason: Example contents and hints are exposed; algorithmic/default/count guarantees are not established by the captured normative paragraph.

claim_assessments.assertion: Channel count and identity must always be derivable from axes alone; derive channel count from axes rather than omero.
claim_assessments.reason: axes provides names/types/order and rank, not lengths or individual channel identities. Array shape is needed for counts; nonstandard/null axes require explicit policy. The proposed sole-axes rule is not supported.

claim_assessments.assertion: Missing omero/rdefs and metadata-count mismatch need explicit fallback rendering/initial selection/robustness policies.
claim_assessments.reason: Valid unexecuted product decisions; no default palette/initial index/count mismatch policy is prescribed.

claim_assessments.assertion: labels group is an image child beside resolution arrays; intermediate groups are allowed and MUST have no metadata; label image names are arbitrary.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: labels group requires a labels path-array; all label images SHOULD be listed, not universally MUST-listed.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: Presence of the associated labels-group structure.

claim_assessments.assertion: Label pixels must use one of uint8/int8/uint16/int16/uint32/int32/uint64/int64.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Label images implement multiscales and have the same number of levels as the original unlabeled image.
claim_assessments.reason: Same level count does not establish matched shapes, transforms or source-image identity; parent wording must follow resolved original source.
governing_conditions: Relative to the original unlabeled image, not automatically any containing primary group.

claim_assessments.assertion: Label dimensions must equal image dimensions or one where irrelevant, listed as a hard obligation; overlay code must broadcast singleton axes.
claim_assessments.reason: The cited layout comment says should, not must, and is explanatory hierarchy material. It cannot establish a hard shape requirement or universal reader broadcasting mandate. Broadcasting may be a supported capability choice after registration checks.

claim_assessments.assertion: image-label and its colors/version are SHOULD, with conditional MUST value types; the optional-capabilities summary also calls the whole block MAY.
claim_assessments.reason: SHOULD is not MAY. Dedicated soft-obligation text is correct, but the unqualified MAY list downgrades the force without supersession.

claim_assessments.assertion: Colors entries key on integer label-value; rgba is optional but must be four integers 0–255, with alpha opacity; additional keys allowed.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: When color entries or rgba are supplied.

claim_assessments.assertion: Readers SHOULD use specified label colors; absent rgba/color metadata requires a product fallback choice.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Worked label example treats alpha 128 as about 50 percent opacity.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported as description of the example, not a mandated exact blending algorithm.

claim_assessments.assertion: Optional properties provide arbitrary per-label metadata and need not share keys; surfacing them is a product decision.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.

claim_assessments.assertion: Optional source object identifies original image; optional image field is a relative path defaulting to ../../.
claim_assessments.reason: Matches the admitted captured source at the cited locators.
governing_conditions: source is optional; if supplied it must be an object; image field is optional but supplied value must be relative path string.

claim_assessments.assertion: Matching transforms/shapes cannot be assumed from level parity; overlay geometry should be verified per level with explicit mismatch handling.
claim_assessments.reason: Useful supported inference. Source says usually matching dimensions/transforms. Saying all of S003:433 is non-normative because descriptive is too broad, but the non-universal usually qualifier correctly defeats assumed transform equality.

claim_assessments.assertion: Aligned overlays are defined as verified equality of per-level transforms/dimensions.
claim_assessments.reason: Equality is a conservative proposed support policy, not necessary registration in general; differently sampled coordinate-compatible labels can align. Also conflicts with its own singleton-broadcast proposal unless equality is qualified.

claim_assessments.assertion: Listed missing names/metadata, duplicate names, rank/order mismatch, transform type/count/order/length violations, collection/XML ordering errors, plate/well identity errors and invalid label values are detectable conformance conditions.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct conditional checklist except independently assessed quoted layout representation and empty-datasets addition.

claim_assessments.assertion: Empty datasets is specifically a sourced conformance violation.
claim_assessments.reason: Source requires datasets list describing arrays, but supplies no explicit list minItems constraint. Empty lists are unusable for this viewer; classify rejection as admission/product policy rather than pretend the cited ordering sentence expressly forbids empty lists.

claim_assessments.assertion: Missing declared level arrays and optional/recommended metadata should produce explicit degradation; absence of omero/image-label is not a hard schema violation.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported product policy. Missing XML and image-label can depart from SHOULD recommendations; not equivalent to violating MUST.

claim_assessments.assertion: Read-only/local-session display settings and exclusion of edit/export/remote are compatible; no specific reader duty to write is imposed in this capture.
claim_assessments.reason: Negative assertion checked against complete capture.

claim_assessments.assertion: Background I/O, cancellation, responsiveness, memory/performance targets and error UX are engineering requirements, not captured OME format rules.
claim_assessments.reason: Complete captured source reviewed. It names chunk features and gives a chunk-size hint but no measured performance, cancellation or UX requirement.

claim_assessments.assertion: Implementations section contains only See Tools; actual reader compatibility/prevalence cannot be established within admitted source universe.
claim_assessments.reason: Correct limitation rather than a false factual finding.

claim_assessments.assertion: Full Zarr v3 schemas/I/O/codecs, OMERO algorithms, OME-XML validation, unit conversions and remote-access rules are absent from the capture.
claim_assessments.reason: Complete source review confirms these references are not complete included specifications. Metadata examples do not establish schema grammar.

claim_assessments.assertion: Plate examples omit mandatory plate.version; well examples omit recommended well.version.
claim_assessments.reason: Checked complete example objects: outer ome.version exists, nested plate/well version does not.

claim_assessments.assertion: Expect real files to inherit example omissions.
claim_assessments.reason: Plausible hypothesis/risk, not observed writer behavior or prevalence; no admitted actual files support it.

claim_assessments.assertion: camelCase guidance coexists with legacy field_count/maximumfieldcount; parse exact keys and do not case-normalize case-sensitive identities.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported source inconsistency and compatibility inference; broader metadata parser choice is a proposal.

claim_assessments.assertion: Mixed uppercase/lowercase keyword use contradicts conformance boilerplate and renders it noise.
claim_assessments.reason: Presence of uppercase and lowercase usage does not prove the boilerplate inconsistent; it can mean keywords are not invariably uppercase. The source explicitly permits descriptive conformance, so calling that sentence noise overstates the evidence.

claim_assessments.assertion: Index refers HCS to 2.2.3, while dedicated HCS hierarchy is 1.2; index navigation can mislead about owner section.
claim_assessments.reason: Supported narrow observation. Not evidence that all index entries are unreliable.

claim_assessments.assertion: Older 0.3/0.4 tooling writes Zarr v2 layouts.
claim_assessments.reason: Admitted source records the 0.5.0 switch to v3 but supplies neither those earlier specifications nor actual writer behavior. Blanket historical tooling assertion exceeds evidence.

claim_assessments.assertion: Proposed fixtures cover 2D/5D, collections with/without series and plate precedence, dense/sparse HCS, label metadata/parity/dtype variants, group-plus-dataset calibration, missing units, malformed metadata and large-pyramid performance; expected checks remain UNEXECUTED.
claim_assessments.reason: Valid design proposals; they are not test results. Broadcast rule force and count-only calibration/precision limitations remain separately assessed.

claim_assessments.assertion: Open real-tool, reader-error, channel metadata mismatch, named-multiscale, fallback rendering, future version policy and HCS scope decisions are acknowledged.
claim_assessments.reason: Legitimate open areas. Acknowledgment does not repair separately emitted unsupported factual assertions or eligible-facet omissions.

claim_assessments.assertion: S003, Viewer.md and brief.md line citations identify admitted source and planning-input line numbers.
claim_assessments.reason: Line counts and locator targets independently checked; exact per-claim support is recorded in each row.

claim_assessments.assertion: Hierarchy version validation is a cheap check.
claim_assessments.reason: Consistency rule is well-defined, but validating a whole hierarchy entails metadata discovery/reads. The source provides no cost or performance evidence. Cheap is an unmeasured engineering expectation, not an established source property.

eligible_facet_coverage.reason: Identifies v3 and attributes.ome version admission, explicit container/version validation and mixed-version negative fixture. Older-tooling factual overreach is separately recorded.
